title: Shopping on Saturday
text:
Tom goes to the shop on Saturday. He needs milk, bread and eggs. The shop is big and has many good things. Tom takes a basket and walks around.

At the counter, Tom pays for his food. The bread costs two dollars. Then he goes home with his bags. He is happy with his shopping.

questions.text: What day does Tom go to the shop?
How much does the bread cost?
Why does Tom take a basket?
How does Tom probably feel at the end of the story?

vocabulary.definition: a place where you buy things
a container used for carrying shopping
a flat table where you pay in a shop
containers made of paper or plastic for carrying things

paragraph_translations: Tom vai à loja no sábado. Ele precisa de leite, pão e ovos. A loja é grande e tem muitas coisas boas. Tom pega uma cesta e anda por ali.
No balcão, Tom paga pela comida. O pão custa dois dólares. Depois ele volta para casa com as suas sacolas. Ele está feliz com as compras.
